clue.text: Stocking up time

parts.note: read as the season when children's stockings are hung up to be filled with presents, not a time for laying in supplies

explanation.surface: A note about when to lay in provisions for the larder.
explanation.definitionFit: Hanging up a stocking for Santa to fill is the custom of the December festival.

clue.text: Cab of pleasing appearance is reported

indicators.note: a report is spoken, so the word for good-looking is said and heard as a different word

parts.note: good-looking means handsome

explanation.surface: A taxi is said to look rather attractive.
explanation.definitionFit: A two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage for hire was the Victorian taxi of that name.

clue.text: This French shrub goes behind one cold cabinet

indicators.note: the French word and the shrub together are placed after the numeral, behind it in the answer

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
ce is French for this
box is an evergreen hedging shrub

explanation.surface: A French bush is planted behind a single chilly cupboard.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned refrigerator, or an insulated chest kept chilled, is a cold storage cabinet.

clue.text: Diplomacy in charge of a skilful device

parts.note: diplomacy is tact, sensitivity in dealing with others

explanation.surface: Diplomatic manners are presented as a clever trick for running things.
explanation.definitionFit: A tactic is a calculated move or ploy to gain an end.

clue.text: Spill the lot

parts.note: spill is slang for confess, so emptying out the whole lot means confessing to all of it

explanation.surface: Someone knocks over every drop of a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To spill the beans completely is to make a full confession.

clue.text: Oracular support the other 99 have

parts.note: a prop is a support

indicators.note: the word the is rendered in an other form, its letters rearranged

parts.note: IC is a Roman numeral, 100 less 1

explanation.surface: An oracle's backing is something that the remaining ninety-nine possess.
explanation.definitionFit: An oracle foretells the future, so oracular speech is foretelling.

clue.text: Give short change due to an omission

indicators.note: change tells us to alter the order of the letters of the preceding two words

explanation.surface: A cashier shortchanging a customer through carelessness.
explanation.definitionFit: An oversight is a failure to notice, a slip of leaving something out.

clue.text: Making a great effort using a sieve

definitions.meaning: struggling hard, exerting oneself to the limit
passing liquid through a mesh to separate out solids

explanation.definitionFit: To strain is both to exert oneself and to filter food through a sieve.

clue.text: Bushes, diminutive couple I treat

definitions.note: the plural is fine since the hedge plant is a mass noun covering many shrubs

parts.note: pr is the shortened form of pair, a couple
to vet is to treat as a veterinary surgeon treats animals

explanation.surface: A tiny pair of people tending some shrubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Privet is a shrub widely grown for hedges.

clue.text: A French greeting not gladly received

parts.note: un is French for a
a welcome is a greeting

explanation.surface: A French hello that was not well taken.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unwelcome is unwanted, not received with pleasure.

clue.text: Not all is in South Africa or in Greece

definitions.note: the definition locates the answer, a city in that country

indicators.note: the phrase for a portion sits inside the abbreviation for the country

parts.note: a part is not all of something

explanation.surface: Wondering whether something partial lies in South Africa or in Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient warrior city-state of the Peloponnese lies in southern Greece.

clue.text: Ill-repute of no right-winger accepting fancy tie

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the conservative politician takes in the reworked word, holding it inside

parts.note: a Tory is a British Conservative, on the political right

indicators.note: fancy as an adjective means elaborate, so the letters of tie are made over

explanation.surface: Disgrace is denied to a Conservative who wears a flashy necktie.
explanation.definitionFit: Notoriety is fame for something bad, a poor reputation.

clue.text: Rock singer to submit calmly

indicators.note: rock means shake, so the letters of singer are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: A rock star is told to give in quietly.
explanation.definitionFit: To resign oneself is to accept something with patience and without protest.

clue.text: Pat, she too became a bone-setter

indicators.note: became says the three words turned into something else, their letters reformed

explanation.surface: Pat and her friend both qualified to treat broken bones.
explanation.definitionFit: This practitioner treats the skeleton and joints by manipulation, as a bone-setter did.

clue.text: One gets messages from posters

parts.note: posters are read as people who post letters, not wall advertisements; the person receives what they send

explanation.surface: Someone takes their information from billboards.
explanation.definitionFit: The person a letter is directed to receives the mail others send.

clue.text: The last one to make a score

definitions.text: The last one to make a score

parts.words: The last one to make a score
parts.note: a score is twenty, so the final item needed to complete a count of twenty, not a goal in a match

explanation.surface: Praise for the player who netted the final goal.
explanation.definitionFit: The item numbered twenty completes a set of twenty, a score.

clue.text: The girl is getting darker all the time according to the poet

definitions.meaning: the first woman in Genesis, a girl's name

definitions.text: getting darker all the time according to the poet
definitions.meaning: evening, the time of day when it grows dark, in its poetic short form

explanation.definitionFit: Eve is a girl's name and also a literary word for evening.

clue.text: Greek character beheaded another

indicators.note: beheading cuts off the head, the first letter of the word

parts.note: another Greek character, the second letter of their alphabet, beta

explanation.surface: One Greek figure decapitated a second.
explanation.definitionFit: Eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Earlier part of the Renaissance

indicators.note: part of says the letters lie within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Referring to the early stretch of the Renaissance.
explanation.definitionFit: Ere is an old word meaning before.

clue.text: It could produce quite a splash at the bar

definitions.text: It could produce quite a splash at the bar

parts.words: It could produce quite a splash at the bar
parts.note: a splash is a dash of fizzy water added to a drink in a pub, not a wet accident

explanation.surface: Something that might cause a messy spill in a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A pressurised bottle that squirts fizzy water is used to add a splash to spirits.

clue.text: He leaves this place going after a measure of land

indicators.note: the shortened word for this place comes after the single letter; the letters running backwards across after a are a coincidence
he leaves means those two letters depart from the word

parts.note: here means this place
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man departs after walking a parcel of farmland.
explanation.definitionFit: An are is a metric unit of area, a hundred square metres.

clue.text: Being wrong to call after a word of hesitation

indicators.note: the word for call follows the hesitation in the answer

parts.note: er is the sound of someone hesitating
to ring is to call on the telephone

explanation.surface: Someone is mistaken to phone after an awkward pause.
explanation.definitionFit: Erring means straying from what is right, making a mistake.

clue.text: Progress through life at a gallop

definitions.meaning: a person's working life and advancement through it

explanation.definitionFit: Career is a person's course through working life and also a headlong rush.

clue.text: Sea-weed that is on the water-sprite

indicators.note: in a down clue the abbreviation sits on, after, the seaweed

parts.note: kelp is a large brown seaweed
ie is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: Seaweed is clinging to a water spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: In Scottish folklore a kelpie is a malevolent horse-shaped water spirit.

clue.text: Highland attendant's lass not right to be dishonest

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, linking definition to wordplay

indicators.note: not right means the abbreviation for right is dropped from the word for lass

parts.note: a lass is a girl
to lie is to be dishonest

explanation.surface: A Scottish servant's girlfriend is going astray and telling fibs.
explanation.definitionFit: A gillie is a Scottish hunting or fishing guide who attends a sportsman.

clue.text: Like 4 perhaps eg a strict manoeuvre

indicators.note: a manoeuvre is a moving about, so the letters of the three words are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: A precise military move is offered as an example of a ploy.
explanation.definitionFit: A tactic, the answer at 4, is a planned move, so it can be called calculated and planned.

clue.text: Father's bird is over the hill

parts.note: pa is father, and pa's adds the s
a tit is a small songbird

explanation.surface: Dad's pet bird is getting old.
explanation.definitionFit: Past it is an idiom for too old to do things well.

clue.text: Long drink containing very soft fruit

parts.note: to pine is to long for

indicators.note: the beer holds the musical marking inside it

parts.note: ale is a drink, a kind of beer
pp is pianissimo, the musical marking for very soft

explanation.surface: A tall glass with a squishy piece of fruit in it.
explanation.definitionFit: The pineapple is a tropical fruit.

clue.text: Deal with unknown contract

parts.note: to treat a matter is to deal with it
y is a mathematical unknown

explanation.surface: Coping with an agreement with a stranger.
explanation.definitionFit: A treaty is a formal agreement between states.

clue.text: Silver mourned and was distressed

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
grieved means mourned

explanation.surface: Someone lamented the lost silver and was upset.
explanation.definitionFit: Aggrieved means upset by a sense of having been wronged.
